Absolution.name: Absolution
Absolution.description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

AbsolutionAltX.name: Absolution of Inspiring
AbsolutionAltX.description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

AbsolutionMinion.description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

AbsolutionMinionEmpowered.name: Empowered Absolution
AbsolutionMinionEmpowered.description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

AbsolutionMinionVaalCascade.name: Absolution Cascade
AbsolutionMinionVaalCascade.description: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.

AbyssalFiendEnfeebleAura.name: Enfeeble
AbyssalFiendEnfeebleAura.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

AbyssalFiendPunishmentAura.name: Punishment
AbyssalFiendPunishmentAura.description: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.

AbyssalFiendTemporalChainsAura.name: Temporal Chains
AbyssalFiendTemporalChainsAura.description: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

Affliction.name: Affliction
Affliction.description: Permanently Afflicts any of your damageable minions in a targeted area, causing them to take physical damage over time, at an accelerating rate. Each such minion causes you to regenerate life at a rate based on the current damage of it's Affliction debuff. Afflicted Minions explode if their life is lowered to a fifth of maximum.

AilmentBearer.name: Unbound Avatar
AilmentBearer.description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

AlchemistsMark.name: Alchemist's Mark
AlchemistsMark.description: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.

Ambush.name: Ambush
Ambush.description: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.

AncestralCry.name: Ancestral Cry
AncestralCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances.

Anger.name: Anger
Anger.description: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

AnimateGuardian.name: Animate Guardian
AnimateGuardian.description: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

AnimateGuardianAltX.name: Animate Guardian of Smiting
AnimateGuardianAltX.description: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

AnimateGuardianSmite.name: Smite
AnimateGuardianSmite.description: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

AnimateGuardiansWeapon.name: Animate Guardian's Weapon
AnimateGuardiansWeapon.description: Animates a copy of your Animated Guardian's main-hand weapon to fight by your side.

AnimateWeapon.name: Animate Weapon
AnimateWeapon.description: Animates a Melee Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

AnimateWeaponAltX.name: Animate Weapon of Self Reflection
AnimateWeaponAltX.description: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines.

AnimateWeaponAltY.name: Animate Weapon of Ranged Arms
AnimateWeaponAltY.description: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

AnimosityUniqueSkill.name: Tears of Rot
AnimosityUniqueSkill.description: While active, this skill inflicts the Weeping Black debuff on impaled enemies you hit with bow attacks. Weeping Black deals physical damage over time, and can stack up to five times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

ApproachingFlames.name: Approaching Flames
ApproachingFlames.description: Become touched by the flames of the Cleansing Fire.

Arc.name: Arc
Arc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

ArcAltX.name: Arc of Surging
ArcAltX.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.

ArcAltY.name: Arc of Oscillating
ArcAltY.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.

ArcaneCloak.name: Arcane Cloak
ArcaneCloak.description: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

ArcaneLink.name: Arcane Link
ArcaneLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional lightning damage based on your mana. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

ArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
ArcticArmour.description: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.

ArmageddonBrand.name: Armageddon Brand
ArmageddonBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

ArmageddonBrandAltX.name: Armageddon Brand of Volatility
ArmageddonBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.

ArmageddonBrandAltY.name: Armageddon Brand of Recall
ArmageddonBrandAltY.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

ArtilleryBallista.name: Artillery Ballista
ArtilleryBallista.description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

ArtilleryBallistaAltX.name: Artillery Ballista of Cross Strafe
ArtilleryBallistaAltX.description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

ArtilleryBallistaAltY.name: Artillery Ballista of Focus Fire
ArtilleryBallistaAltY.description: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.

AspectOfArakaali.name: Aspect of Arakaali
AspectOfArakaali.description: While active, you inflict Wither on hit, and Wither you inflict will be reflected back to you. Additionally, for each stack of Wither on you, your Life recovery rate is increased.

AspectOfLunaris.name: Aspect of Lunaris
AspectOfLunaris.description: While active, taking Physical or Elemental Damage will grant you either Lunar Protection or Lunar Resistance, respectively. Aspect of Lunaris lessens incoming Physical Damage for each Lunar Protection on you, and lessens incoming Elemental Damage for each Lunar Resistance on you. These buffs can both stack up to eight times.

AspectOfSolaris.name: Aspect of Solaris
AspectOfSolaris.description: While active, inflicts Fire Exposure on enemies within its radius. Additionally, periodically applies a Sunscald debuff to enemies within its radius, with each Sunscald debuff increasing the effect of exposure on affected enemies. Sunscald can stack up to five times.

AspectOfTheAvian.name: Aspect of the Avian
AspectOfTheAvian.description: While active, grants the Avian's Might and Avian's Flight buffs in sequence. Avian's Might grants you and your minions a chance to deal Double Damage with hits for a duration. Avian's Flight grants you and your minions increased Movement Speed for a secondary duration.

AspectOfTheBrineKing.name: Aspect of the Brine King
AspectOfTheBrineKing.description: While active, inflicts Chill on enemies within it's radius, while also increasing the strength of Chill you inflict and causing Damage you deal to Chilled enemies to penetrate some of their Cold Resistance.

AspectOfTheCat.name: Aspect of the Cat
AspectOfTheCat.description: While active, grants the Cat's Stealth and Cat's Agility buffs in sequence. Cat's Stealth increases your critical strike chance, makes you harder to see, and gives you a chance to avoid damage for a short duration. Cat's Agility increases your attack and cast speed for a longer secondary duration.

AspectOfTheCrab.name: Aspect of the Crab
AspectOfTheCrab.description: While active, periodically adds Crab Barriers to you, and grants additional Physical Damage reduction for each Crab Barrier you have. All Crab Barriers are lost when you take physical damage from a hit.

AspectOfTheSpider.name: Aspect of the Spider
AspectOfTheSpider.description: While active, periodically applies a Spider's Web debuff to nearby Enemies, and Hinders them. Each Spider's Web on an Enemy increases the Damage they take. Hinder reduces their movement speed.

AssassinsMark.name: Assassin's Mark
AssassinsMark.description: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

AtlasCrusaderJudgeBallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
AtlasCrusaderJudgeBallLightning.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

AtlasCrusaderSisterMortarSpectre.name: Mortar
AtlasCrusaderSisterMortarSpectre.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AtlasEyrieArcherMortar.name: Mortar
AtlasEyrieArcherMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AtlasEyrieKiwethMortarSpectre.name: Mortar
AtlasEyrieKiwethMortarSpectre.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AtziriUniqueStaffFlameblast.name: Flames of Judgement
AtziriUniqueStaffFlameblast.description: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

AtziriUniqueStaffStormCall.name: Storm of Judgement
AtziriUniqueStaffStormCall.description: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

Autoexertion.name: Autoexertion
Autoexertion.description: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered.

Automation.name: Automation
Automation.description: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered.

AvengingFlame.name: Avenging Flame
AvengingFlame.description: Launches a fiery projectile high into the air, to drop on a target and deal area damage where it lands.

AxisCasterGlacialCascade.name: Glacial Cascade
AxisCasterGlacialCascade.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

AxisDoubleStrikeTrigger.name: Double Strike
AxisDoubleStrikeTrigger.description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

AxisEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
AxisEnfeeble.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

AxisTemporalChains.name: Temporal Chains
AxisTemporalChains.description: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

AzmeriAdmiralDashMortars.name: Dash Mortars
AzmeriAdmiralDashMortars.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AzmeriAdmiralPrecision.name: Precision
AzmeriAdmiralPrecision.description: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.

AzmeriArgusMeleeAtAnimationSpeed.name: Default Attack
AzmeriArgusMeleeAtAnimationSpeed.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

AzmeriBarrageDemonRainOfSpines.name: Rain of Arrows
AzmeriBarrageDemonRainOfSpines.description: Fires a large number of arrows into the air, to land at the target after a short delay.

AzmeriBarrageDemonSpinestorm.name: Firestorm
AzmeriBarrageDemonSpinestorm.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar.name: Mortar
AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar2.name: Mortar 2
AzmeriBasiliskShoulderMortar2.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

AzmeriBirdGrace.name: Grace
AzmeriBirdGrace.description: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.

AzmeriCasterDemonSpellDamageAura.name: Zealotry
AzmeriCasterDemonSpellDamageAura.description: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.

AzmeriCycloneDemonDesecratedGroundCyclon.name: Cyclone
AzmeriCycloneDemonDesecratedGroundCyclon.description: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.

AzmeriDemonPhysicalDamageAura.name: Pride
AzmeriDemonPhysicalDamageAura.description: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.

AzmeriDoubleSlashAnimatedWeapon.name: Lacerate
AzmeriDoubleSlashAnimatedWeapon.description: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.

AzmeriDualStrikeDemonDualStrike.name: Dual Strike
AzmeriDualStrikeDemonDualStrike.description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

AzmeriFireFuryMoltenStrike.name: Molten Strike
AzmeriFireFuryMoltenStrike.description: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.

AzmeriGeofriSmite.name: Smite
AzmeriGeofriSmite.description: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

AzmeriGoddessDiscipline.name: Discipline
AzmeriGoddessDiscipline.description: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.

AzmeriGolemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
AzmeriGolemLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

AzmeriHailrakeArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
AzmeriHailrakeArcticArmour.description: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.

AzmeriHailrakeGlacialCascade.name: Glacial Cascade
AzmeriHailrakeGlacialCascade.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

AzmeriHailrakeGlacialHammer.name: Glacial Hammer
AzmeriHailrakeGlacialHammer.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

AzmeriHydraHatred.name: Hatred
AzmeriHydraHatred.description: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.

AzmeriKudukuShockNova.name: Shock Nova
AzmeriKudukuShockNova.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

AzmeriKudukuSparkExtraProj.name: Spark
AzmeriKudukuSparkExtraProj.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

AzmeriKudukuWarp.name: Lightning Warp
AzmeriKudukuWarp.description: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.

AzmeriKudukuWrath.name: Wrath
AzmeriKudukuWrath.description: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.

AzmeriLightningMelee.name: Default Attack
AzmeriLightningMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

AzmeriMegaSkeletonCleave.name: Cleave
AzmeriMegaSkeletonCleave.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

AzmeriMegaSkeletonHeavyMelee.name: Heavy Melee
AzmeriMegaSkeletonHeavyMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

AzmeriOakLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
AzmeriOakLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

AzmeriOakSweep.name: Holy Sweep
AzmeriOakSweep.description: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down holy hammers to land randomly on a number of enemies struck. Hits from these holy hammers cannot be evaded.

AzmeriOakVitality.name: Vitality
AzmeriOakVitality.description: Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies.

AzmeriOversoulColdSnapTriggered.name: Cold Snap
AzmeriOversoulColdSnapTriggered.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

AzmeriOversoulRocksTriggered.name: Rain of Boulders
AzmeriOversoulRocksTriggered.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

AzmeriPhantasmClarity.name: Clarity
AzmeriPhantasmClarity.description: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.

AzmeriReaperMelee.name: Default Attack
AzmeriReaperMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

AzmeriSawbladeAnimatedWeaponCyclone.name: Cyclone
AzmeriSawbladeAnimatedWeaponCyclone.description: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.

AzmeriTigerHaste.name: Haste
AzmeriTigerHaste.description: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

AzmeriTurtleDetermination.name: Determination
AzmeriTurtleDetermination.description: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.

AzmeriVikingCyclone.name: Cyclone
AzmeriVikingCyclone.description: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.

BallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
BallLightning.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

BallLightningAltX.name: Ball Lightning of Orbiting
BallLightningAltX.description: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

BallLightningAltY.name: Ball Lightning of Static
BallLightningAltY.description: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.

BanditChampionBlastRainSpectre.name: Blast Rain
BanditChampionBlastRainSpectre.description: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.

BanditExplosiveArrowAtAnimationSpeed.name: Explosive Arrow
BanditExplosiveArrowAtAnimationSpeed.description: Fires an arrow which acts as a short duration fuse. Applying additional arrows to an enemy extends the duration. When the target dies or the fuses expire, the arrows explode, dealing fire AoE damage to nearby enemies. The AoE radius is proportional to the number of arrows upon death.

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.description: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

BaneAltX.name: Bane of Condemnation
BaneAltX.description: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Barkskin.name: Barkskin
Barkskin.description: Adopt the power of the forest, gradually covering your body in bark. Getting hit by enemy attacks causes bark to be removed. You take reduced damage from physical attack hits the more bark builds up, but higher chance to evade when less covered in bark.

BarnacleSnap.name: Savage Barnacle
BarnacleSnap.description: Creates a giant barnacle that continually snaps at enemies, dealing off-hand area damage augmented by the defences of the shield. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which damage occurs.

Barrage.name: Barrage
Barrage.description: After a short preparation time, you fire individual projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.

BarrageAltX.name: Barrage of Volley Fire
BarrageAltX.description: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.

BattlemagesCry.name: Battlemage's Cry
BattlemagesCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance.

BattlemagesCrySupport.name: Battlemage's Cry
BattlemagesCrySupport.description: Supports spell skills, causing them to be triggered. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

BearTrap.name: Bear Trap
BearTrap.description: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

BearTrapAltX.name: Bear Trap of Skewers
BearTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate to increase the effects of Rage.

BirdmanBloodProjectileMortar.name: Blood Projectile
BirdmanBloodProjectileMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

BitingBraidNova.name: Caustic Retribution
BitingBraidNova.description: When hit, release a nova of venomous bile that deals spell chaos damage. This nova poisons and hinders on hit.

BladeBlast.name: Blade Blast
BladeBlast.description: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way.

BladeBlastAltX.name: Blade Blast of Unloading
BladeBlastAltX.description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.

BladeBlastAltY.name: Blade Blast of Dagger Detonation
BladeBlastAltY.description: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.

BladeFlurry.name: Blade Flurry
BladeFlurry.description: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

BladeFlurryAltX.name: Blade Flurry of Incision
BladeFlurryAltX.description: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

BladeTrap.name: Blade Trap
BladeTrap.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through.

BladeTrapAltX.name: Blade Trap of Greatswords
BladeTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through

BladeTrapAltY.name: Blade Trap of Laceration
BladeTrapAltY.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.

BladeVortex.name: Blade Vortex
BladeVortex.description: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.

BladeVortexAltX.name: Blade Vortex of the Scythe
BladeVortexAltX.description: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.

Bladefall.name: Bladefall
Bladefall.description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

BladefallAltX.name: Bladefall of Volleys
BladefallAltX.description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

BladefallAltY.name: Bladefall of Impaling
BladefallAltY.description: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.

BladefallAltZ.name: Bladefall of Trarthus
BladefallAltZ.description: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Bladestorm.name: Bladestorm
Bladestorm.description: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

BladestormAltX.name: Bladestorm of Uncertainty
BladestormAltX.description: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.

BlastRain.name: Blast Rain
BlastRain.description: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.

BlastRainAltX.name: Blast Rain of Trarthus
BlastRainAltX.description: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.

BlazingSalvo.name: Blazing Salvo
BlazingSalvo.description: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.

Blight.name: Blight
Blight.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

BlightAltX.name: Blight of Contagion
BlightAltX.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.

BlightAltY.name: Blight of Atrophy
BlightAltY.description: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

BlinkArrow.name: Blink Arrow
BlinkArrow.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

BlinkArrowAltX.name: Blink Arrow of Bombarding Clones
BlinkArrowAltX.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

BlinkArrowAltY.name: Blink Arrow of Prismatic Clones
BlinkArrowAltY.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

BlinkMirrorArrowMelee.name: Projectile Attack
BlinkMirrorArrowMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

BloodAndSand.name: Blood and Sand
BloodAndSand.description: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

BloodFlower.name: Goreblossom
BloodFlower.description: Creates a bloody Bloom of gore and flesh. Allies near this Bloom will gain additional physical damage over time multiplier. Multiple instances of this buff can stack. Enemies near it will take physical damage over time. Only the most damaging instance of this debuff will affect an enemy near multiple Blooms.

BloodOffering.name: Blood Offering
BloodOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.

BloodRage.name: Blood Rage
BloodRage.description: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.

BloodSacramentUnique.name: Blood Sacrament
BloodSacramentUnique.description: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.

BloodShrineUniqueTriggeredExplodingToad.name: Explosive Toad
BloodShrineUniqueTriggeredExplodingToad.description: A toad spawns from the corpse of the slain enemy, leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing forty percent of the slain enemy's Life as Chaos Damage. This skill's damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

Bodyswap.name: Bodyswap
Bodyswap.description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

BodyswapAltX.name: Bodyswap of Sacrifice
BodyswapAltX.description: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

BoneArmour.name: Bone Armour
BoneArmour.description: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

BoneGolemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
BoneGolemLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

BoneNova.name: Bone Nova
BoneNova.description: Bones erupt around enemies you hit, dealing physical damage.

BoneOffering.name: Bone Offering
BoneOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

BoneStalkerEarthquake.name: Earthquake
BoneStalkerEarthquake.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

Boneshatter.name: Boneshatter
Boneshatter.description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

BoneshatterAltX.name: Boneshatter of Complex Trauma
BoneshatterAltX.description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

BoneshatterAltY.name: Boneshatter of Carnage
BoneshatterAltY.description: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

BrandRecall.name: Brand Recall
BrandRecall.description: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate.

BrandSupport.name: Arcanist Brand
BrandSupport.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

Brandsurge.name: Brandsurge
Brandsurge.description: Overcharges your brands near the targeted area, causing them to accelerate how quickly they activate and expire. Deals damage in an area around each overcharged brand when it expires.

BreachArc.name: Breach Arc
BreachArc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

BreachCleave.name: Cleave
BreachCleave.description: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

BreachHandTrap.name: Will of the Lords
BreachHandTrap.description: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.

BreachLightningWhip.name: Breach Lightning Whip
BreachLightningWhip.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

BurningArrow.name: Burning Arrow
BurningArrow.description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

BurningArrowAltX.name: Burning Arrow of Vigour
BurningArrowAltX.description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

CageSpiderCycloneTriggerSandstorms.name: Cyclone
CageSpiderCycloneTriggerSandstorms.description: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.

CageSpiderSandSpark.name: Sandstorm
CageSpiderSandSpark.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

CallOfSteel.name: Call of Steel
CallOfSteel.description: Calls impale debuffs from enemies, alive or dead, in a large area around you to gain steel shards. Deals reflected damage in a smaller area around each such enemy based on the impales removed from them. Continues to grant shards over time until you reach maximum or spend them.

CatsStealthTriggeredIntimidatingCry.name: Intimidating Cry
CatsStealthTriggeredIntimidatingCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.

CausticArrow.name: Caustic Arrow
CausticArrow.description: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

CausticArrowAltX.name: Caustic Arrow of Poison
CausticArrowAltX.description: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.

CeaselessFleshUnique.name: Ceaseless Flesh
CeaselessFleshUnique.description: Once per second, raise a nearby corpse as a shambling undead. This minion will follow you and attack your enemies with melee strikes, but quickly falls apart. These minions have significantly increased attack speed while on low life.

ChainHook.name: Chain Hook
ChainHook.description: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

ChainHookAltX.name: Chain Hook of Angling
ChainHookAltX.description: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you.

ChainHookAltY.name: Chain Hook of Trarthus
ChainHookAltY.description: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

ChannelledSnipeSupport.name: Snipe
ChannelledSnipeSupport.description: Supports bow attack skills. Cannot support channelled skills, instant skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

ChaosElementalCascadeSummoned.name: Cascade
ChaosElementalCascadeSummoned.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

ChargedDash.name: Charged Dash
ChargedDash.description: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

ChargedDashAltX.name: Charged Dash of Projection
ChargedDashAltX.description: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

Clarity.name: Clarity
Clarity.description: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

CleaveAltX.name: Cleave of Rage
CleaveAltX.description: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.

CobraLash.name: Cobra Lash
CobraLash.description: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

ColdAegis.name: Cold Aegis
ColdAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes cold damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking cold damage from hits, or if depleted.

ColdSnap.name: Cold Snap
ColdSnap.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

ColdSnapAltX.name: Cold Snap of Power
ColdSnapAltX.description: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

Combust.name: Combust
Combust.description: Deals attack damage in an area.

Conductivity.name: Conductivity
Conductivity.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.

Conflagration.name: Conflagration
Conflagration.description: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.

ConsecratedPath.name: Consecrated Path
ConsecratedPath.description: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

ConsecratedPathAltX.name: Consecrated Path of Endurance
ConsecratedPathAltX.description: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

Contagion.name: Contagion
Contagion.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

ContagionAltX.name: Contagion of Subsiding
ContagionAltX.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.

ContagionAltY.name: Contagion of Transference
ContagionAltY.description: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.

ConversionTrap.name: Conversion Trap
ConversionTrap.description: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.

Convocation.name: Convocation
Convocation.description: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.

CorpseWalk.name: Corpse Walk
CorpseWalk.description: Spawns corpses around you while you move, based on monsters in the current area. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

CorruptingFever.name: Corrupting Fever
CorruptingFever.description: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupting Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires.

CracklingLance.name: Crackling Lance
CracklingLance.description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

CracklingLanceAltX.name: Crackling Lance of Branching
CracklingLanceAltX.description: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

CracklingLanceAltY.name: Crackling Lance of Disintegration
CracklingLanceAltY.description: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.

CreateFungalGroundOnKill.name: Contaminate
CreateFungalGroundOnKill.description: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.

CreepingFrost.name: Creeping Frost
CreepingFrost.description: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

CreepingFrostAltX.name: Creeping Frost of Floes
CreepingFrostAltX.description: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

Cremation.name: Cremation
Cremation.description: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

CremationAltX.name: Cremation of Exhuming
CremationAltX.description: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

CremationAltY.name: Cremation of the Volcano
CremationAltY.description: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.

CrucibleIceStormTrap.name: Ice Storm
CrucibleIceStormTrap.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

CrucibleVendigoFlickerStrike.name: Flicker Strike
CrucibleVendigoFlickerStrike.description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

CrushingFist.name: Crushing Fist
CrushingFist.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area.

Cyclone.name: Cyclone
Cyclone.description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

CycloneAltX.name: Cyclone of Tumult
CycloneAltX.description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

DancingDervishCycloneChannelled.name: Cyclone
DancingDervishCycloneChannelled.description: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

DarkPact.name: Dark Bargain
DarkPact.description: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain beams to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

DarkPactAltX.name: Dark Bargain of Trarthus
DarkPactAltX.description: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.

Dash.name: Dash
Dash.description: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

DeathAura.name: Death Aura
DeathAura.description: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

DeathWalk.name: Death Walk
DeathWalk.description: While you walk, this skill causes corpses near your steps to explode, dealing fire damage in an area. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

DeathWish.name: Death Wish
DeathWish.description: As you channel this spell, it spreads its effect to more of your minions. When you stop channelling, each affected minion explodes, and this skill deals spell damage around them.  The explosion of the minion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

DecoyTotem.name: Decoy Totem
DecoyTotem.description: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.

DefianceBanner.name: Defiance Banner
DefianceBanner.description: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

DelveMelee.name: Default Attack (Cold DoT)
DelveMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

DelveMeleeCold.name: Default Attack (Cold Hit)
DelveMeleeCold.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

DelveMonsterEnfeebleOnHit.name: Enfeeble
DelveMonsterEnfeebleOnHit.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

DelveSpiderFlickerStrike.name: Flicker Strike (Cold Hit)
DelveSpiderFlickerStrike.description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

DemonModularBladeVortexSpectre.name: Blade Vortex
DemonModularBladeVortexSpectre.description: An ethereal blade spins around you for a duration, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.

Desecrate.name: Desecrate
Desecrate.description: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

Despair.name: Despair
Despair.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.

DestructiveLink.name: Destructive Link
DestructiveLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Determination.name: Determination
Determination.description: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.

DetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead
DetonateDead.description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

DetonateDeadAltX.name: Detonate Dead of Scavenging
DetonateDeadAltX.description: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.

DetonateDeadAltY.name: Detonate Dead of Chain Reaction
DetonateDeadAltY.description: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

DevouringTotem.name: Devouring Totem
DevouringTotem.description: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.

Discharge.name: Discharge
Discharge.description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

DischargeAltX.name: Discharge of Misery
DischargeAltX.description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

Discipline.name: Discipline
Discipline.description: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.

DivineBlast.name: Divine Blast
DivineBlast.description: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration, before blasting outwards in a larger and more damaging explosion.

DivineBlastAltX.name: Divine Blast of Radiance
DivineBlastAltX.description: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.

DivineIre.name: Divine Ire
DivineIre.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.

DivineIreAltX.name: Divine Ire of Holy Lightning
DivineIreAltX.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.

DivineIreAltY.name: Divine Ire of Disintegration
DivineIreAltY.description: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.

DivineRetribution.name: Divine Retribution
DivineRetribution.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

DominatingBlow.name: Dominating Blow
DominatingBlow.description: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

DominatingBlowAltX.name: Dominating Blow of Inspiring
DominatingBlowAltX.description: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

DominatingBlowMinionCharge.name: Shield Charge
DominatingBlowMinionCharge.description: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.

DoomBlast.name: Doom Blast
DoomBlast.description: Deals chaos damage in an area.

DoryanisTouch.name: Doryani's Touch
DoryanisTouch.description: The character uses their fist to slam the ground in front of them, with less attack speed, but more damage. This attack deals Lightning Damage to enemies in a large area, with a chance to Shock them. Cannot be used while wielding a Weapon. Cannot be Evaded.

DoubleStrike.name: Double Strike
DoubleStrike.description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

DoubleStrikeAltX.name: Double Strike of Impaling
DoubleStrikeAltX.description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.

DoubleStrikeAltY.name: Double Strike of Momentum
DoubleStrikeAltY.description: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.

DreadBanner.name: Dread Banner
DreadBanner.description: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

DropBearSummonedGroundSlam.name: Ground Slam
DropBearSummonedGroundSlam.description: The character slams the ground in front of them with a Staff, Mace or Sceptre, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun.

DualStrike.name: Dual Strike
DualStrike.description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

DualStrikeAltX.name: Dual Strike of Ambidexterity
DualStrikeAltX.description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

EarthquakeAltX.name: Earthquake of Amplification
EarthquakeAltX.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

Earthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Earthshatter.description: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

EarthshatterAltX.name: Earthshatter of Fragility
EarthshatterAltX.description: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

EarthshatterAltY.name: Earthshatter of Prominence
EarthshatterAltY.description: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

ElementalAegis.name: Elemental Aegis
ElementalAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.

ElementalHit.name: Elemental Hit
ElementalHit.description: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

ElementalHitAltX.name: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum
ElementalHitAltX.description: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.

ElementalHitCloneShot.name: Elemental Hit
ElementalHitCloneShot.description: Each attack with this skill will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

ElementalHitSkeletonKnight.name: Elemental Hit Fire

It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

ElementalWarding.name: Elemental Warding
ElementalWarding.description: Fires projectiles in all directions, converting all their physical damage to a random element, and grants a buff which makes you unaffected by curses for a duration. Removes curses on you when used.

ElementalWeakness.name: Elemental Weakness
ElementalWeakness.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.

EmbraceMadness.name: Embrace Madness
EmbraceMadness.description: Grants Glorious Madness. Using this skill again will remove Glorious Madness and the Touched Debuffs it inflicts, but you will be unable to Embrace Madness again until the cooldown expires.

EnchantmentOfWarOnKill.description: This attack is performed repeatedly by a ghostly imitation of your weapon.

EnchantmentOfWinterWhenHit.description: Unleashes an icy projectile that pulses with cold as it travels.

EnchantmentOfWinterWhenHit2.name: Edict of Winter
EnchantmentOfWinterWhenHit2.description: Unleashes an icy projectile that pulses with cold as it travels.
