EnchantmentOfWinterWhenHit4.name: Commandment of Winter
EnchantmentOfWinterWhenHit4.description: Unleashes an icy projectile that pulses with cold as it travels.

EnduringCry.name: Enduring Cry
EnduringCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.

EnergyBlade.name: Energy Blade
EnergyBlade.description: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped swords into swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered or used with non-sword weapons.

Enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

EnsnaringArrow.name: Ensnaring Arrow
EnsnaringArrow.description: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

Envy.name: Envy
Envy.description: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

EssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain
EssenceDrain.description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

EssenceDrainAltX.name: Essence Drain of Desperation
EssenceDrainAltX.description: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

EssenceDrainAltY.name: Essence Drain of Wickedness
EssenceDrainAltY.description: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.

EtherealKnives.name: Ethereal Knives
EtherealKnives.description: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

EtherealKnivesAltX.name: Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades
EtherealKnivesAltX.description:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.

EtherealKnivesAltY.name: Ethereal Knives of the Massacre
EtherealKnivesAltY.description: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.

Eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
Eviscerate.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield.

ExplosiveArrow.name: Explosive Arrow
ExplosiveArrow.description: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.

ExplosiveConcoction.name: Explosive Concoction
ExplosiveConcoction.description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

ExplosiveConcoctionAltX.name: Explosive Concoction of Destruction
ExplosiveConcoctionAltX.description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

ExplosiveTrap.name: Explosive Trap
ExplosiveTrap.description: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

ExplosiveTrapAltX.name: Explosive Trap of Shrapnel
ExplosiveTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

ExplosiveTrapAltY.name: Explosive Trap of Magnitude
ExplosiveTrapAltY.description: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.

Exsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
Exsanguinate.description: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils.

ExsanguinateAltX.name: Exsanguinate of Transmission
ExsanguinateAltX.description: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.

EyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
EyeOfWinter.description: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.

EyeOfWinterAltX.name: Eye of Winter of Finality
EyeOfWinterAltX.description: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.

EyeOfWinterAltY.name: Eye of Winter of Transience
EyeOfWinterAltY.description: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.

FaridunCasterUndeadDamageOverTimeAura.name: Malevolence
FaridunCasterUndeadDamageOverTimeAura.description: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.

FemaleCannibalBossFireStorm.name: Firestorm
FemaleCannibalBossFireStorm.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

FemaleCannibalBossFlameDash.name: Flame Dash
FemaleCannibalBossFlameDash.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

FieryImpactHeistMaceImplicit.name: Fiery Impact
FieryImpactHeistMaceImplicit.description: Deals attack damage in an area.

FireAegis.name: Fire Aegis
FireAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes fire damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking fire damage from hits, or if depleted.

FireBurstOnHit.name: Fire Burst
FireBurstOnHit.description: A burst of flame errupts from the location of a hit, dealing fire damage.

FireElementalFlameRedSummoned.name: Immolate
FireElementalFlameRedSummoned.description: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.

FireElementalMortarSummoned.name: Magma Ball
FireElementalMortarSummoned.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

FireMonsterWhirlingBlades.name: Fire Roll
FireMonsterWhirlingBlades.description: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

FireTrap.name: Fire Trap
FireTrap.description: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.

FireTrapAltX.name: Fire Trap of Blasting
FireTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

FireballAltX.name: Fireball of Radiation
FireballAltX.description: Unleashes a ball of fire ahead that inflicts a short but powerful fire damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

FireballIncursionChaos.name: Chaos Ball
FireballIncursionChaos.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

FireballIncusionFire.name: Fireball
FireballIncusionFire.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

FireballIncusionLightning.name: Lightning Ball
FireballIncusionLightning.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

Firestorm.name: Firestorm
Firestorm.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

FirestormAltX.name: Firestorm of Meteors
FirestormAltX.description: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

FirestormAltY.name: Firestorm of Pelting
FirestormAltY.description: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

FlameDash.name: Flame Dash
FlameDash.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

FlameDashAltY.name: Flame Dash of Return
FlameDashAltY.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

FlameLink.name: Flame Link
FlameLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

FlameSurge.name: Flame Surge
FlameSurge.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

FlameSurgeAltX.name: Flame Surge of Combusting
FlameSurgeAltX.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

FlameWall.name: Flame Wall
FlameWall.description: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.

FlamebearerFlameBlue.name: Blue Flame
FlamebearerFlameBlue.description: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.

Flameblast.name: Flameblast
Flameblast.description: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

FlameblastAltX.name: Flameblast of Celerity
FlameblastAltX.description: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

FlameblastAltY.name: Flameblast of Contraction
FlameblastAltY.description: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.

FlamethrowerTrap.name: Flamethrower Trap
FlamethrowerTrap.description: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.

FlamethrowerTrapAltX.name: Flamethrower Trap of Stability
FlamethrowerTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.

Flammability.name: Flammability
Flammability.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.

FleshAndStone.name: Flesh and Stone
FleshAndStone.description: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

FleshOffering.name: Flesh Offering
FleshOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

FlickerStrike.name: Flicker Strike
FlickerStrike.description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

FlickerStrikeAltX.name: Flicker Strike of Power
FlickerStrikeAltX.description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

Focus.name: Focus
Focus.description: Focus your power, granting yourself the Focused buff.

FogOfWar.name: Fog of War
FogOfWar.description: Creates a Smoke Cloud in an area, which blinds enemies within it.

ForbiddenRite.name: Forbidden Rite
ForbiddenRite.description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

ForbiddenRiteAltX.name: Forbidden Rite of Soul Sacrifice
ForbiddenRiteAltX.description: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.

FreezingPulse.name: Freezing Pulse
FreezingPulse.description: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.

Frenzy.name: Frenzy
Frenzy.description: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

FrenzyAltX.name: Frenzy of Onslaught
FrenzyAltX.description: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

FrostBlades.name: Frost Blades
FrostBlades.description: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.

FrostBladesAltX.name: Frost Blades of Katabasis
FrostBladesAltX.description: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.

FrostBolt.name: Frostbolt
FrostBolt.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.

FrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb
FrostBomb.description: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

FrostBombAltX.name: Frost Bomb of Instability
FrostBombAltX.description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

FrostBombAltY.name: Frost Bomb of Forthcoming
FrostBombAltY.description: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

FrostShield.name: Frost Shield
FrostShield.description: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once.

FrostWall.name: Frost Wall
FrostWall.description: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.

Frostblink.name: Frostblink
Frostblink.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

FrostblinkAltX.name: Frostblink of Wintry Blast
FrostblinkAltX.description: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

FrozenLegion.name: Frozen Legion
FrozenLegion.description: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

FrozenLegionAltX.name: Frozen Legion of Rallying
FrozenLegionAltX.description: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

FrozenSweep.name: Frozen Sweep
FrozenSweep.description: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.

FrozenSweepAltX.name: Frozen Sweep
FrozenSweepAltX.description: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.

GalvanicArrow.name: Galvanic Arrow
GalvanicArrow.description: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

GalvanicArrowAltX.name: Galvanic Arrow of Energy
GalvanicArrowAltX.description: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

GalvanicArrowAltY.name: Galvanic Arrow of Surging
GalvanicArrowAltY.description: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target

GalvanicField.name: Galvanic Field
GalvanicField.description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.

GalvanicFieldAltX.name: Galvanic Field of Intensity
GalvanicFieldAltX.description: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

GemDetonateMines.name: Detonate Mines
GemDetonateMines.description: Detonates a Mine, starting a Detonation Sequence which will detonate other Mines around it.

GeneralsCry.name: General's Cry
GeneralsCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.

GeneralsCrySupport.name: General's Cry
GeneralsCrySupport.description: Supports melee attack skills without a cooldown. Those skills will be used by Mirage Warriors summoned by General's Cry. Supported skills cannot be supported by Multistrike.

GhostCannons.name: Ghostly Artillery
GhostCannons.description: Manifest a row of Ghostly Cannons, each of which then fires after a short delay dealing the damage of the weapon that triggered it. For each additional projectile this skill would fire, create an additional Ghostly Cannon instead.

GhostPirateBladeVortexSpectre.name: Blade Vortex
GhostPirateBladeVortexSpectre.description: An ethereal blade spins around you for a duration, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.

GlacialCascade.name: Glacial Cascade
GlacialCascade.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.

GlacialCascadeAltX.name: Glacial Cascade of the Fissure
GlacialCascadeAltX.description: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

GlacialHammer.name: Glacial Hammer
GlacialHammer.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

GlacialHammerAltX.name: Glacial Hammer of Shattering
GlacialHammerAltX.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

GlacialShieldSwipe.name: Glacial Shield Swipe
GlacialShieldSwipe.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.

GluttonyOfElements.name: Gluttony of Elements
GluttonyOfElements.description: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.

GoatmanEarthquake.name: Earthquake
GoatmanEarthquake.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

GoatmanFireMagmaOrb.name: Magma Orb
GoatmanFireMagmaOrb.description: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.

GoatmanMoltenShell.name: Molten Shell
GoatmanMoltenShell.description: Summons fiery elemental shields providing additional armour for a short duration. If cumulative physical damage prevented by your blocking or armour reaches a threshold, the shields explode outwards, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

GoreShockwave.name: Gore Shockwave
GoreShockwave.description: Deals attack damage in an area.

Grace.name: Grace
Grace.description: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.

GrimBonfire.name: Witchhunter's Pyre
GrimBonfire.description:
Create a burning Bonfire of corpses at the targeted location. This Bonfire will deal fire damage over time to surrounding enemies. Bonfires created this way are considered to be totems.
Bonfires periodically release fiery projectiles which target nearby burning enemies. An additional projectile will be fired at a given target for each additional burning debuff on that target.

GroundSlam.name: Ground Slam
GroundSlam.description: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

GroundSlamAltX.name: Ground Slam of Earthshaking
GroundSlamAltX.description: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.

GuardianArc.name: Arc
GuardianArc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

HalfSkeletonPuncture.name: Puncture
HalfSkeletonPuncture.description: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.

HarvestRhexLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
HarvestRhexLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

Haste.name: Haste
Haste.description: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

Hatred.name: Hatred
Hatred.description: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.

HeavyStrike.name: Heavy Strike
HeavyStrike.description: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.

HeavyStrikeAltY.name: Heavy Strike of Trarthus
HeavyStrikeAltY.description: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.

HeistCultistUnarmedLeap.name: Whirling Blades
HeistCultistUnarmedLeap.description: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

HeistProjectUnarmedMelee1.name: Default Attack
HeistProjectUnarmedMelee1.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

HeistThugRangedExplosiveArrow.name: Explosive Arrow (20 Fuses)
HeistThugRangedExplosiveArrow.description: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.

HellscapeFleshFodderArc.name: Scourge Arc
HellscapeFleshFodderArc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

HeraldOfAgony.name: Herald of Agony
HeraldOfAgony.description: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.

HeraldOfAgonyMinionCleave.name: Cleave
HeraldOfAgonyMinionCleave.description: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

HeraldOfAgonyMinionMortar.name: Mortar
HeraldOfAgonyMinionMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

HeraldOfAsh.name: Herald of Ash
HeraldOfAsh.description: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time).

HeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
HeraldOfIce.description: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

HeraldOfPurity.name: Herald of Purity
HeraldOfPurity.description: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.

HeraldOfTheBreach.name: Herald of the Hive
HeraldOfTheBreach.description: Grants a buff which causes you to deal more damage for each Herald skill affecting you. While you have this buff, this skill turns the space around you into a tear in reality, releasing pulses that damage enemies around you. Inflicting Ailments causes you to gain Otherworldly Pressure, which increases the frequency of the pulses. You will lose Otherworldly Pressure over time, at a rate which increases the more of it you have. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

HeraldOfThunder.name: Herald of Thunder
HeraldOfThunder.description: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

Hexblast.name: Hexblast
Hexblast.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

HexblastAltX.name: Hexblast of Contradiction
HexblastAltX.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.

HexblastAltY.name: Hexblast of Havoc
HexblastAltY.description: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target.

HolyFireElementalFireball.name: Fireball
HolyFireElementalFireball.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

HolyFlameTotem.name: Holy Flame Totem
HolyFlameTotem.description: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.

HolyFlameTotemAltX.name: Holy Flame Totem of Ire
HolyFlameTotemAltX.description: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.

HolyHammers.name: Holy Hammers
HolyHammers.description: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

HolyHammersAltX.name: Holy Hammers of Spirals
HolyHammersAltX.description: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

HolyStrike.name: Holy Strike
HolyStrike.description: Infuse your weapon with holy energy and swing. Successfully hitting an enemy will summon forth a copy of your Main Hand weapon as a Holy Armament. These Holy Armaments are undamageable minions, and will attack the enemies you target with Holy Strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

HolyStrikeMinionAttack.name: Default Attack
HolyStrikeMinionAttack.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

Hydrosphere.name: Hydrosphere
Hydrosphere.description: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.

IceCrash.name: Ice Crash
IceCrash.description: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

IceCrashAltX.name: Ice Crash of Cadence
IceCrashAltX.description: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.

IceCrashAzmeriHailrake.name: Ice Crash
IceCrashAzmeriHailrake.description: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

IceElementalIceCyclone.name: Cyclone
IceElementalIceCyclone.description: Damage enemies around you, then perform a spinning series of attacks as you travel to a target location. Cannot be supported by Ruthless or Multistrike.

IceNova.name: Ice Nova
IceNova.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

IceNovaAltX.name: Ice Nova of Frostbolts
IceNovaAltX.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.

IceNovaAltY.name: Ice Nova of Deep Freeze
IceNovaAltY.description: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

IceShot.name: Ice Shot
IceShot.description: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.

IceShotAltX.name: Ice Shot of Penetration
IceShotAltX.description: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.

IceSpear.name: Ice Spear
IceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

IceSpearAltX.name: Ice Spear of Splitting
IceSpearAltX.description: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

IceTrap.name: Ice Trap
IceTrap.description: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

IceTrapAltX.name: Ice Trap of Hollowness
IceTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

Icestorm.name: Icestorm
Icestorm.description: Icy bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and chilling them, as well as causing patches of chilled ground. Skill damage is based on Intelligence.

IcicleBurst.name: Icicle Burst
IcicleBurst.description: This attack fires icy projectiles in a circle around enemies you hit, dealing attack damage with all physical damage converted to cold.

IcicleMine.name: Icicle Mine
IcicleMine.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

IcicleMineAltX.name: Icicle Mine of Fanning
IcicleMineAltX.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

IcicleMineAltY.name: Icicle Mine of Sabotage
IcicleMineAltY.description: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

IllusoryWarp.name: Illusory Warp
IllusoryWarp.description: Teleport to a target destination. Chilled ground is spread in an area around both where the caster was and where they teleported to.

ImmortalCall.name: Immortal Call
ImmortalCall.description: Take less Physical and Elemental Damage for a short time. Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges to lengthen the buff and further lessen Physical Damage taken. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

Incinerate.name: Incinerate
Incinerate.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

IncinerateAltX.name: Incinerate of Expanse
IncinerateAltX.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

IncinerateAltY.name: Incinerate of Venting
IncinerateAltY.description: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.

IncursionLeapSlamChampion.name: Leap Slam
IncursionLeapSlamChampion.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

InfernalBlow.name: Infernal Blow
InfernalBlow.description: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

InfernalBlowAltX.name: Infernal Blow of Immolation
InfernalBlowAltX.description: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

InfernalCry.name: Infernal Cry
InfernalCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants a portion of their physical damage as extra fire damage. In addition to being taunted, enemies are inflicted with a secondary debuff causing them to explode when they die, dealing fire damage in an area.

IntimidatingCry.name: Intimidating Cry
IntimidatingCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.

IntuitiveLink.name: Intuitive Link
IntuitiveLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

KaomFireBeamTotemSpectre.name: Scorching Ray Totem
KaomFireBeamTotemSpectre.description: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

KaomWarriorMoltenStrike.name: Molten Strike
KaomWarriorMoltenStrike.description: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.

KineticBlast.name: Kinetic Blast
KineticBlast.description: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

KineticBlastAltX.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering
KineticBlastAltX.description: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

KineticBolt.name: Kinetic Bolt
KineticBolt.description: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.

KineticBoltAltX.name: Kinetic Bolt of Fragmentation
KineticBoltAltX.description: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.

KineticFusillade.name: Kinetic Fusillade
KineticFusillade.description: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

KineticFusilladeAltX.name: Kinetic Fusillade of Detonation
KineticFusilladeAltX.description: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

KineticRain.name: Kinetic Rain
KineticRain.description: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

KineticRainAltX.name: Kinetic Rain of Impact
KineticRainAltX.description: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.

KineticRainKineticInstability.name: Kinetic Anomaly
KineticRainKineticInstability.description: Gathers kinetic energy into an anomaly at the targeted location, which will explode when enemies are near it, dealing your wand's damage in an area. The anomaly will dissipate after a duration.

KitavaDemonCleave.name: Cleave
KitavaDemonCleave.description: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

KitavaDemonLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
KitavaDemonLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

KitavaDemonWhirlingBlades.name: Whirling Blades
KitavaDemonWhirlingBlades.description: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

KitavaSlavedriverFlameWhip.name: Flame Surge
KitavaSlavedriverFlameWhip.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

Lacerate.name: Lacerate
Lacerate.description: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.

LacerateAltX.name: Lacerate of Butchering
LacerateAltX.description: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.

LacerateAltY.name: Lacerate of Haemorrhage
LacerateAltY.description: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.

LancingSteel.name: Lancing Steel
LancingSteel.description: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

LancingSteelAltX.name: Lancing Steel of Spraying
LancingSteelAltX.description: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.

LeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
LeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

LeapSlamAltX.name: Leap Slam of Groundbreaking
LeapSlamAltX.description: Jump a short distance through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

LegionKaruiMeleeLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
LegionKaruiMeleeLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

LegionTemplarJudgeBallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
LegionTemplarJudgeBallLightning.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

LegionTemplarJudgeStormCall.name: Storm Call
LegionTemplarJudgeStormCall.description: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.

LightningAegis.name: Lightning Aegis
LightningAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes lightning damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking lightning damage from hits, or if depleted.

LightningArrow.name: Lightning Arrow
LightningArrow.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

LightningArrowAltX.name: Lightning Arrow of Electrocution
LightningArrowAltX.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.

LightningBolt.name: Lightning Bolt
LightningBolt.description: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.

LightningConduit.name: Lightning Conduit
LightningConduit.description: Lightning strikes all Shocked enemies around a targeted location, then removes Shock from those enemies. Shocks cannot expire on enemies in range while casting this spell. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade or Unleash.

LightningConduitAltX.name: Lightning Conduit of the Heavens
LightningConduitAltX.description: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

LightningSpireTrap.name: Lightning Spire Trap
LightningSpireTrap.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

LightningSpireTrapAltX.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Zapping
LightningSpireTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

LightningSpireTrapAltY.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Overloading
LightningSpireTrapAltY.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

LightningStrike.name: Lightning Strike
LightningStrike.description: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

LightningStrikeAltX.name: Lightning Strike of Arcing
LightningStrikeAltX.description: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

LightningTendrils.name: Lightning Tendrils
LightningTendrils.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

LightningTendrilsAltX.name: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity
LightningTendrilsAltX.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.

LightningTendrilsAltY.name: Lightning Tendrils of Escalation
LightningTendrilsAltY.description: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you.

LightningTrap.name: Lightning Trap
LightningTrap.description: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

LightningTrapAltX.name: Lightning Trap of Sparking
LightningTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

LightningWarp.name: Lightning Warp
LightningWarp.description: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.

MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitLarge.name: Large Vomit
MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitLarge.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitMedium.name: Medium Vomit
MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitMedium.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MMSAzmeriDemonBloodVomitSmall.name: Small Vomit

MMSAzmeriShepherdVomitMortar.name: Vomit Mortar

MMSHeistRobotClockworkGolemMortarSpectre.name: Frost Mortar
MMSHeistRobotClockworkGolemMortarSpectre.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MMSHellscapeDemonEliteTripleMortar.name: Triple Mortal
MMSHellscapeDemonEliteTripleMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MMSHellscapeDemonEliteVomitMortar.name: Vomit Mortar
MMSHellscapeDemonEliteVomitMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MMSPyromaniacIceMortar.name: Ice Mortar
MMSPyromaniacIceMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

Malevolence.name: Malevolence
Malevolence.description: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.

ManaInfusedStaff.name: Mana-Infused Staff
ManaInfusedStaff.description: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.

Manabond.name: Manabond
Manabond.description: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.

ManifestDancingDervishes.name: Manifest Dancing Dervishes
ManifestDancingDervishes.description: Manifests two Dancing Dervishes to fight by your side. While a Dancing Dervish is manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use Weapons. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.

Melee.name: Default Attack
Melee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MeleeAtAnimationSpeed.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MeleeCold.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MeleeFire.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MeleePartialChaos.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MeleeUseContactPoint.name: Default Attack
MeleeUseContactPoint.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

MirrorArrow.name: Mirror Arrow
MirrorArrow.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

MirrorArrowAltX.name: Mirror Arrow of Bombarding Clones
MirrorArrowAltX.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

MirrorArrowAltY.name: Mirror Arrow of Prismatic Clones
MirrorArrowAltY.description: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

MistyReflection.name: Misty Reflection
MistyReflection.description: Dash backwards, leaving a short-lived mist copy of yourself that Taunts nearby Enemies for a short duration. The copy can be damaged by Enemies, and copies that are killed by an Enemy will apply a debuff in an area that makes affected targets take 30% increased Damage and deal 30% less Damage for 4 seconds.

MoltenShell.name: Molten Shell
MoltenShell.description: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

MoltenStrike.name: Molten Strike
MoltenStrike.description: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.

MoltenStrikeAltX.name: Molten Strike of the Zenith
MoltenStrikeAltX.description: Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles.

MonsterArc.name: Arc
MonsterArc.description: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

MonsterCausticArrow.name: Caustic Arrow
MonsterCausticArrow.description: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

MonsterCausticArrowAtAnimationSpeed.name: Caustic Arrow
MonsterCausticArrowAtAnimationSpeed.description: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

MonsterChanceToTemporalChainsOnHit1.name: Temporal Chains
MonsterChanceToTemporalChainsOnHit1.description: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

MonsterDischarge.name: Discharge
MonsterDischarge.description: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.

MonsterEnduringCry.name: Enduring Cry
MonsterEnduringCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.

MonsterFireBomb.name: Fire Bomb
MonsterFireBomb.description: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.

MonsterFireballContactPos.name: Fireball
MonsterFireballContactPos.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

MonsterFlameRedCannibal.name: Incinerate
MonsterFlameRedCannibal.description: Summons a totem that fires a stream of flame at nearby enemies.

MonsterFlickerStrike.name: Flicker Strike
MonsterFlickerStrike.description: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

MonsterIceShot.name: Ice Shot
MonsterIceShot.description: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.

MonsterLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
MonsterLeapSlam.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

MonsterLeapSlamFoothills.name: Leap Slam
MonsterLeapSlamFoothills.description: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.

MonsterLesserMultiFireballSpectre.name: Lesser Multi Fireball
MonsterLesserMultiFireballSpectre.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

MonsterLesserMultiIceSpear.name: Lesser Multi Ice Spear
MonsterLesserMultiIceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

MonsterLightningArrow.name: Lightning Arrow
MonsterLightningArrow.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

MonsterMultiFireballSpectre.name: Multi Fireball
MonsterMultiFireballSpectre.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

MonsterMultiIceSpear.name: Multi Ice Spear
MonsterMultiIceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

MonsterProjectileWeakness.name: Projectile Weakness
MonsterProjectileWeakness.description: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

MonsterPuncture.name: Puncture
MonsterPuncture.description: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.

MonsterRighteousFireWhileSpectred.name: Unrighteous Fire
MonsterRighteousFireWhileSpectred.description: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.

MonsterShockNova.name: Shock Nova
MonsterShockNova.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

MonsterSpark.name: Spark
MonsterSpark.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

MonsterSplitFireballSpectre.name: Split Fireball
MonsterSplitFireballSpectre.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

MonsterSplitIceSpear.name: Split Ice Spear
MonsterSplitIceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

MonsterViperStrike.name: Viper Strike
MonsterViperStrike.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

MonsterViperStrikeAtAnimationSpeed.name: Viper Strike
MonsterViperStrikeAtAnimationSpeed.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

MonsterVulnerabilityOnHit1.name: Vulnerability
MonsterVulnerabilityOnHit1.description: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding, and ailments inflicted on them will deal damage faster.

MonsterWarlordsMark.name: Warlord's Mark
MonsterWarlordsMark.description: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

MotherOfFlamesMagmaOrb3.name: Rolling Magma
MotherOfFlamesMagmaOrb3.description: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.

MountainGoatmanIceSpear.name: Ice Spear
MountainGoatmanIceSpear.description: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

NecromancerConductivity.name: Conductivity
NecromancerConductivity.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.

NecromancerElementalWeakness.name: Elemental Weakness
NecromancerElementalWeakness.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.

NecromancerEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
NecromancerEnfeeble.description: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.

NecromancerFlammability.name: Flammability
NecromancerFlammability.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.

NecromancerFrostbite.name: Frostbite
NecromancerFrostbite.description: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.

NecromancerProjectileWeakness.name: Projectile Weakness
NecromancerProjectileWeakness.description: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

NecromancerRaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
NecromancerRaiseZombie.description: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.

NecromancerVulnerability.name: Vulnerability
NecromancerVulnerability.description: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.

OrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
OrbOfStorms.description: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

OrbOfStormsAltX.name: Orb of Storms of Squalls
OrbOfStormsAltX.description: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

Pacify.name: Pacify
Pacify.description: Curses all targets in an area, having no effect at first, but causing them to deal no damage once 60% of the curse's duration has expired.

PactOfBeidat.name: Pact of Beidat
PactOfBeidat.description: Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.
flavourText: Wield the gifts of Beidat, luminary of the pale unseeing,
whose honeyed words bore tunnels through pliant minds.

PactOfGhorr.name: Pact of Ghorr
PactOfGhorr.description: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically.
flavourText: Offer yourself to Ghorr, the gluttonous, the cage of
flesh trapping souls in the cycle of consumption.

PactOfKtash.name: Pact of K'Tash
PactOfKtash.description: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and regain consumed souls on use.
flavourText: Unleash the fury of K'Tash, incarnation of hate.
Endless bodies burn beneath the flames of his pursuit.

PactOfLycia.name: Pact of Lycia
PactOfLycia.description: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling.
flavourText: Call upon Lycia, conduit of the Scourge. She forfeit
her soul for the power to condemn lies told by bones.

PenanceBrand.name: Penance Brand
PenanceBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

PenanceBrandAltX.name: Penance Brand of Dissipation
PenanceBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

PenanceBrandAltY.name: Penance Brand of Conduction
PenanceBrandAltY.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.

PenanceMark.name: Penance Mark
PenanceMark.description: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.

Perforate.name: Perforate
Perforate.description: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

PerforateAltX.name: Perforate of Duality
PerforateAltX.description: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

PerforateAltY.name: Perforate of Bloodshed
PerforateAltY.description:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe.

PestilentStrike.name: Pestilent Strike
PestilentStrike.description: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.

PetrifiedBlood.name: Petrified Blood
PetrifiedBlood.description: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.

PhaseRun.name: Phase Run
PhaseRun.description: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration.

PhysicalAegis.name: Physical Aegis
PhysicalAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes physical damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking physical damage from hits, or if depleted.

PlagueBearer.name: Plague Bearer
PlagueBearer.description: Gain an Incubating buff, adding to its Plague Value as you inflict poisons. Use the skill again to begin Infecting, dealing chaos damage over time to nearby enemies until the Plague Value is depleted. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this skill's damage. Using the skill again alternates between Incubating and Infecting.

PoachersMark.name: Poacher's Mark
PoachersMark.description: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

PoisonousConcoction.name: Poisonous Concoction
PoisonousConcoction.description: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

PoisonousConcoctionAltX.name: Poisonous Concoction of Bouncing
PoisonousConcoctionAltX.description: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

Portal.name: Portal
Portal.description: Creates a portal to the current area's town.

PowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon
PowerSiphon.description: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

PowerSiphonAltX.name: Power Siphon of the Archmage
PowerSiphonAltX.description: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

Precision.name: Precision
Precision.description: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.

Pride.name: Pride
Pride.description: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.

PrimalAegis.name: Primal Aegis
PrimalAegis.description: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.

PrismaticBurst.name: Prismatic Burst
PrismaticBurst.description: Chooses an element at random and deals damage of that type in an area. Having higher strength makes it more likely to choose fire, higher dexterity makes it more likely to choose cold, and higher intelligence makes it more likely to choose lightning.

ProtectiveLink.name: Protective Link
ProtectiveLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Puncture.name: Puncture
Puncture.description: Punctures enemies with your Bow, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration.

PunctureAltX.name: Puncture of Shanking
PunctureAltX.description: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords.

Punishment.name: Punishment
Punishment.description: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.

PurifyingFlame.name: Purifying Flame
PurifyingFlame.description: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

PurifyingFlameAltX.name: Purifying Flame of Revelations
PurifyingFlameAltX.description: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

PurityOfElements.name: Purity of Elements
PurityOfElements.description: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.

PurityOfFire.name: Purity of Fire
PurityOfFire.description: Casts an aura that grants fire resistance to you and your allies.

PurityOfIce.name: Purity of Ice
PurityOfIce.description: Casts an aura that grants cold resistance to you and your allies.

PurityOfLightning.name: Purity of Lightning
PurityOfLightning.description: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.

PyroChaosFireball.name: Chaos Fireball
PyroChaosFireball.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

PyroFireball.name: Fireball
PyroFireball.description: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

PyroclastMine.name: Pyroclast Mine
PyroclastMine.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

value.value: Area in which projectiles will land:

PyroclastMineAltX.name: Pyroclast Mine of Sabotage
PyroclastMineAltX.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

value.value: Area in which projectiles will land:

QueensDemand.name: Queen's Demand
QueensDemand.description: Alternates triggering Flames of Judgement and Storm of Judgement

QuickGuard.name: Steelskin
QuickGuard.description: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

QuickstepHardMode.name: Quickstep
QuickstepHardMode.description: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.

RageVortex.name: Rage Vortex
