RageVortex.description: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. Sacrifices some rage to send a ragestorm forward. While enemies are inside it, the ragestorm will slow its movement and repeatedly deal attack damage based on your attack speed.

RageVortexAltX.name: Rage Vortex of Berserking
RageVortexAltX.description: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out.

RagingSpiritMeleeAttack.name: Default Attack
RagingSpiritMeleeAttack.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

RainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows
RainOfArrows.description: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

RainOfArrowsAltX.name: Rain of Arrows of Artillery
RainOfArrowsAltX.description: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.

RainOfArrowsAltY.name: Rain of Arrows of Saturation
RainOfArrowsAltY.description: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

RainOfArrowsCloneShot.name: Rain of Arrow
RainOfArrowsCloneShot.description: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

RaiseSpectre.name: Raise Spectre
RaiseSpectre.description: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a minion to fight for you in battle.

RaiseSpectreAltX.name: Raise Spectre of Transience
RaiseSpectreAltX.description: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration.

RaiseSpiders.name: Raise Spiders
RaiseSpiders.description: Raise two spectral spiders from each nearby corpse that will attack your enemies with Viper Strike. Each raised spider grants you increased Attack Speed and increased Damage with Poison. Enemies will not engage the spiders directly, and they are immune to damage.

RaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
RaiseZombie.description: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.

RaiseZombieAltX.name: Raise Zombie of Slamming
RaiseZombieAltX.description: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam.

RaiseZombieAltY.name: Raise Zombie of Falling
RaiseZombieAltY.description: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.

RallyingCry.name: Rallying Cry
RallyingCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon.

Ravenous.name: Ravenous
Ravenous.description: Consumes a targeted corpse, granting you a buff that gives you bonuses against enemies of the same monster category as the corpse.

Reap.name: Reap
Reap.description: A bloody scythe swipes across a selected area, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

ReapAltX.name: Reap of Butchery
ReapAltX.description: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

Reave.name: Reave
Reave.description: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

ReaveAltX.name: Reave of Refraction
ReaveAltX.description: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

RejuvenationTotem.name: Rejuvenation Totem
RejuvenationTotem.description: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.

RepeatingShockwave.name: Abberath's Fury
RepeatingShockwave.description: While you run, this skill creates a small explosion with each step, dealing fire damage in an area around you.

ResentmentUniqueSkill.name: Cinders
ResentmentUniqueSkill.description: While active, your bow attacks inflict Cinderflame. Cinderflame deals fire damage over time, and can stack up to ten times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

RighteousFire.name: Righteous Fire
RighteousFire.description: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.

RighteousFireAltX.name: Righteous Fire of Arcane Devotion
RighteousFireAltX.description: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana.

RockGolemMinionWhirlingBlades.name: Roll
RockGolemMinionWhirlingBlades.description: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

RollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
RollingMagma.description: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.

RuneBlast.name: Rune Blast
RuneBlast.description: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction.

RuneBlastAltX.name: Rune Blast of Teleportation
RuneBlastAltX.description: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction. Detonation can teleport you to the targeted Rune.

ScorchingRay.name: Scorching Ray
ScorchingRay.description: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

ScorchingRayAltX.name: Scorching Ray of Immolation
ScorchingRayAltX.description: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

ScourgeArrow.name: Scourge Arrow
ScourgeArrow.description: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows.

ScourgeArrowAltX.name: Scourge Arrow of Menace
ScourgeArrowAltX.description: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.

SearingBond.name: Searing Bond
SearingBond.description: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.

SearingBondAltX.name: Searing Bond of Detonation
SearingBondAltX.description: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.

SeawitchFrostbolt.name: Frostbolt
SeawitchFrostbolt.description: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.

SeawitchVulnerability.name: Vulnerability
SeawitchVulnerability.description: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.

SecretDesecrateMonsterEarthquakeTriggere.name: Earthquake
SecretDesecrateMonsterEarthquakeTriggere.description: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

SeismicCry.name: Seismic Cry
SeismicCry.description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.

SeismicTrap.name: Seismic Trap
SeismicTrap.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

SeismicTrapAltX.name: Seismic Trap of Swells
SeismicTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

parts.name: Average waves hitting configured size enemy

ShadeForm.name: Shade Form
ShadeForm.description: Makes you immune to physical damage, and harder for enemies to detect, for a duration.

ShaperApparitionBeam.name: Shaper's Ire
ShaperApparitionBeam.description: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire a damaging beam for a duration that deals damage over time to things in it.

ShaperApparitionProjectiles.name: Shaper's Despair
ShaperApparitionProjectiles.description: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire piercing projectiles in front of you that deal cold damage.

ShaperApparitionTeleportSlam.name: Shaper's Devastation
ShaperApparitionTeleportSlam.description: Shaper's Memory uses this attack for you to teleport to an enemy and attack with a powerful blow, dealing area damage based on your weapon.

ShatteringSteel.name: Shattering Steel
ShatteringSteel.description: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter.

ShatteringSteelAltX.name: Shattering Steel of Ammunition
ShatteringSteelAltX.description: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

ShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
ShieldCharge.description: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing off-hand damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.

ShieldCrush.name: Shield Crush
ShieldCrush.description: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

ShieldCrushAltX.name: Shield Crush of the Chieftain
ShieldCrushAltX.description: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

ShieldOfLight.name: Shield of Light
ShieldOfLight.description: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target.

ShieldShatter.name: Shield Shatter
ShieldShatter.description: Your shield shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the shield's quality. For a short duration after this, you will be unable to block and will gain no defences from your shield, but your spells will deal added physical damage.

ShockNova.name: Shock Nova
ShockNova.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

ShockNovaAltX.name: Shock Nova of Procession
ShockNovaAltX.description: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.

ShockwaveTotem.name: Shockwave Totem
ShockwaveTotem.description: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies

ShockwaveTotemAltX.name: Shockwave Totem of Authority
ShockwaveTotemAltX.description: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.

ShrapnelBallista.name: Shrapnel Ballista
ShrapnelBallista.description: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.

ShrapnelBallistaAltX.name: Shrapnel Ballista of Steel
ShrapnelBallistaAltX.description: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

SiegeBallista.name: Siege Ballista
SiegeBallista.description: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.

SiegeBallistaAltX.name: Siege Ballista of Splintering
SiegeBallistaAltX.description:
Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
Requires a Bow.

SiegeBallistaAltY.name: Siege Ballista of Trarthus
SiegeBallistaAltY.description: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.

SigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power
SigilOfPower.description: Places a Sigil on the ground, which grants a buff to you and allies in the area around it for a duration. The Sigil gains stages as you spend mana in its area, making the buff more powerful. You can only have one Sigil of Power at a time.

SignalPrey.name: Signal Prey
SignalPrey.description: Applies a debuff to a specific enemy which signals your minions to consider that enemy to be the Prey. All minions from skills supported by any Predator Support will target that enemy. Only one enemy can be the Prey at a time. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

SiphoningTrap.name: Siphoning Trap
SiphoningTrap.description: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.

SiphoningTrapAltX.name: Siphoning Trap of Pain
SiphoningTrapAltX.description: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.

SkeletonArcherLightningArrow.name: Lightning Arrow
SkeletonArcherLightningArrow.description: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

SkeletonBlackAbyssBoneLance.name: Unearth
SkeletonBlackAbyssBoneLance.description: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands.

SkeletonCannonMortar.name: Mortar
SkeletonCannonMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

SkeletonSoldierTornadoShot.name: Tornado Shot
SkeletonSoldierTornadoShot.description: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.

SkeletonSpark.name: Spark
SkeletonSpark.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

SkeletonVulnerability.name: Vulnerability
SkeletonVulnerability.description: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.

SlavedriverFlameWhip.name: Lightning Surge
SlavedriverFlameWhip.description: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.description: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

SmiteAltX.name: Smite of Divine Judgement
SmiteAltX.description: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

SmokeMine.name: Smoke Mine
SmokeMine.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that Blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

Snipe.name: Snipe
Snipe.description: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.

SnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark
SnipersMark.description: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

SolarisChampionFlameVortex.name: Flame Vortex
SolarisChampionFlameVortex.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

SolartwineBlindingNova.name: Blazing Glare
SolartwineBlindingNova.description: When hit, release a nova of fiery vengeance, dealing spell fire damage and blinding enemies struck.

SomaticShell.name: Somatic Shell
SomaticShell.description: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.

SoulLink.name: Soul Link
SoulLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Soulrend.name: Soulrend
Soulrend.description: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

SoulrendAltX.name: Soulrend of Reaping
SoulrendAltX.description: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.

SoulrendAltY.name: Soulrend of the Spiral
SoulrendAltY.description: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.

Spark.name: Spark
Spark.description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

SparkAltX.name: Spark of the Nova
SparkAltX.description: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

SparkAltY.name: Spark of Unpredictability
SparkAltY.description: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.

SpectralHelix.name: Spectral Helix
SpectralHelix.description: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.

SpectralHelixAltY.name: Spectral Helix of Trarthus
SpectralHelixAltY.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

SpectralShieldThrow.name: Spectral Shield Throw
SpectralShieldThrow.description: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

SpectralShieldThrowAltX.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Shattering
SpectralShieldThrowAltX.description: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

SpectralShieldThrowAltY.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Trarthus
SpectralShieldThrowAltY.description: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

SpectralSkullShieldCharge.name: Charge
SpectralSkullShieldCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled.

SpectralSpirits.name: Spectral Spirits
SpectralSpirits.description: Summons three invulnerable spectral skulls that rush at nearby enemies and attack them rapidly. Enemies will not engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

SpectralThrow.name: Spectral Throw
SpectralThrow.description: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.

SpectralThrowAltX.name: Spectral Throw of Materialising
SpectralThrowAltX.description: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.

SpectralThrowAltY.name: Spectral Throw of Trarthus
SpectralThrowAltY.description: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.description: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack.

SpiritBurst.name: Spirit Burst
SpiritBurst.description: Consumes a spirit charge to fire projectiles which deals physical damage.

SpiritOffering.name: Spirit Offering
SpiritOffering.description: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

SplitArrow.name: Split Arrow
SplitArrow.description: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

SplitArrowAltX.name: Split Arrow of Splitting
SplitArrowAltX.description: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.

SplittingSteel.name: Splitting Steel
SplittingSteel.description: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.

SplittingSteelAltX.name: Splitting Steel of Ammunition
SplittingSteelAltX.description: Consume Steel Shards to fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

StalkingPustule.name: Stalking Pustule
StalkingPustule.description: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

StaticStrike.name: Static Strike
StaticStrike.description: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining static energy for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have static energy, you'll frequently hit a number of nearby enemies with beams, dealing attack damage.

StaticStrikeAltX.name: Static Strike of Gathering Lightning
StaticStrikeAltX.description: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have.

StormBrand.name: Storm Brand
StormBrand.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

StormBrandAltX.name: Storm Brand of Indecision
StormBrandAltX.description: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

StormBurst.name: Storm Burst
StormBurst.description: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

StormBurstAltX.name: Storm Burst of Repulsion
StormBurstAltX.description: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

StormCall.name: Storm Call
StormCall.description: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.

StormCallAltX.name: Storm Call of Trarthus
StormCallAltX.description: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.

StormCascadeTriggered.name: Storm Cascade
StormCascadeTriggered.description: Lightning crackles in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

StormRain.name: Storm Rain
StormRain.description: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

StormRainAltX.name: Storm Rain of the Conduit
StormRainAltX.description: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.

StormRainAltY.name: Storm Rain of the Fence
StormRainAltY.description: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

Stormbind.name: Stormbind
Stormbind.description: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

StormbindAltX.name: Stormbind of Teleportation
StormbindAltX.description: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

StormblastMine.name: Stormblast Mine
StormblastMine.description: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.

SummonAbyssalConstructs.name: Summon Bone Feeders
SummonAbyssalConstructs.description: Summon two Bone Feeders which follow you around. Bone Feeders consume corpses they walk over, creating a temporary Aura after consuming 10 corpses. One Bone Feeder creates a Curse Aura of either Temporal Chains, Enfeeble or Punishment that ignores Curse Limits. The other Bone Feeder creates an Aura that causes Enemy Damage with Hits to be Unlucky.

SummonArbalists.name: Summon Arbalists
SummonArbalists.description: Summons Arbalist minions which use projectile attacks.

SummonBeastialRhoa.name: Summon Bestial Rhoa
SummonBeastialRhoa.description: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

SummonBeastialSnake.name: Summon Bestial Snake
SummonBeastialSnake.description: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

SummonBeastialUrsa.name: Summon Bestial Ursa
SummonBeastialUrsa.description: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

SummonCarrionGolem.name: Summon Carrion Golem
SummonCarrionGolem.description: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

SummonCarrionGolemAltX.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Hordes
SummonCarrionGolemAltX.description: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.

SummonCarrionGolemAltY.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Scavenging
SummonCarrionGolemAltY.description: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

SummonChaosGolem.name: Summon Chaos Golem
SummonChaosGolem.description: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

SummonChaosGolemAltX.name: Summon Chaos Golem of Hordes
SummonChaosGolemAltX.description: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

SummonChaosGolemAltY.name: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelstrom
SummonChaosGolemAltY.description: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.
SummonChaosGolemAltY.baseTypeName: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström

SummonDoedresEffigy.name: Summon Doedre's Effigy
SummonDoedresEffigy.description: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.

SummonElementalRelic.name: Summon Elemental Relic
SummonElementalRelic.description: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.

SummonFlameGolem.name: Summon Flame Golem
SummonFlameGolem.description: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

SummonFlameGolemAltX.name: Summon Flame Golem of Hordes
SummonFlameGolemAltX.description: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

SummonFlameGolemAltY.name: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
SummonFlameGolemAltY.description: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.
SummonFlameGolemAltY.baseTypeName: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor

SummonHarbingerOfBrutality.name: Summon Harbinger of Brutality
SummonHarbingerOfBrutality.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.

SummonHarbingerOfBrutalityUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Brutality
SummonHarbingerOfBrutalityUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.

SummonHarbingerOfDirections.name: Summon Harbinger of Directions
SummonHarbingerOfDirections.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.

SummonHarbingerOfDirectionsUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Directions
SummonHarbingerOfDirectionsUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.

SummonHarbingerOfFocus.name: Summon Harbinger of Focus
SummonHarbingerOfFocus.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.

SummonHarbingerOfFocusAscendancy.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Focus
SummonHarbingerOfFocusAscendancy.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.

SummonHarbingerOfFocusUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Focus
SummonHarbingerOfFocusUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.

SummonHarbingerOfStorms.name: Summon Harbinger of Storms
SummonHarbingerOfStorms.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

SummonHarbingerOfStormsUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Storms
SummonHarbingerOfStormsUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

SummonHarbingerOfTheArcane.name: Summon Harbinger of the Arcane
SummonHarbingerOfTheArcane.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.

SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneAscendancy.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of the Arcane
SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneAscendancy.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.

SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of the Arcane
SummonHarbingerOfTheArcaneUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.

SummonHarbingerOfTime.name: Summon Harbinger of Time
SummonHarbingerOfTime.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.

SummonHarbingerOfTimeAscendancy.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Time
SummonHarbingerOfTimeAscendancy.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.

SummonHarbingerOfTimeUber.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Time
SummonHarbingerOfTimeUber.description: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.

SummonHolyRelic.name: Summon Holy Relic
SummonHolyRelic.description: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.

SummonHolyRelicAltX.name: Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
SummonHolyRelicAltX.description: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.

SummonIceGolem.name: Summon Ice Golem
SummonIceGolem.description: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

SummonIceGolemAltX.name: Summon Ice Golem of Hordes
SummonIceGolemAltX.description: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

SummonIceGolemAltY.name: Summon Ice Golem of Shattering
SummonIceGolemAltY.description: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.

SummonLightningGolem.name: Summon Lightning Golem
SummonLightningGolem.description: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

SummonLightningGolemAltX.name: Summon Lightning Golem of Hordes
SummonLightningGolemAltX.description: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

SummonMirageChieftain.name: Tawhoa's Chosen
SummonMirageChieftain.description: This skill is triggered when you use a Slam or Strike skill, and summons a Mirage Chieftain who will use that Slam or Strike skill once before dissipating.

SummonRagingSpirit.name: Summon Raging Spirit
SummonRagingSpirit.description: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

SummonRagingSpiritAltX.name: Summon Raging Spirit of Enormity
SummonRagingSpiritAltX.description: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

SummonReaper.name: Summon Reaper
SummonReaper.description: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.

SummonReaperAltX.name: Summon Reaper of Revenants
SummonReaperAltX.description: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.

SummonReaperAltY.name: Summon Reaper of Eviscerating
SummonReaperAltY.description: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

SummonSacredWisp.name: Summon Sacred Wisps
SummonSacredWisp.description: This skill is triggered by supported skills to summon Sacred Wisps which use the triggering skill when you do.

SummonSentinelOfRadiance.name: Summon Sentinel of Radiance
SummonSentinelOfRadiance.description: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.

SummonShaperApparition.name: Summon Shaper Memory
SummonShaperApparition.description: Consume Remembrance to summon a memory of the Shaper, which will use a skill once before fading away.

SummonSkeletons.name: Summon Skeletons
SummonSkeletons.description: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies.

SummonSkeletonsAltX.name: Summon Skeletons of Archers
SummonSkeletonsAltX.description: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration.

SummonSkeletonsAltY.name: Summon Skeletons of Mages
SummonSkeletonsAltY.description: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration.

SummonSkitterbots.name: Summon Skitterbots
SummonSkitterbots.description: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged.

SummonSpectralTiger.name: Summon Spectral Tiger
SummonSpectralTiger.description: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

SummonSpectralWolf.name: Summon Spectral Wolf
SummonSpectralWolf.description: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

SummonStoneGolem.name: Summon Stone Golem
SummonStoneGolem.description: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

SummonStoneGolemAltX.name: Summon Stone Golem of Hordes
SummonStoneGolemAltX.description: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

SummonStoneGolemAltY.name: Summon Stone Golem of Safeguarding
SummonStoneGolemAltY.description: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

SummonTauntingContraption.name: Summon Taunting Contraption
SummonTauntingContraption.description: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.

SummonVoidSpawn.name: Summon Void Spawn
SummonVoidSpawn.description: Summon a Void Spawn minion, which casts a lightning projectile spell with a chance to shock enemies.

SummonedLivingLightningZap.name: Living Lightning Zap
SummonedLivingLightningZap.description: Jolt through an enemy, causing chaining Lightning Damage.

SummonedReaperMelee.name: Default Attack
SummonedReaperMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

SummonedRhoaShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
SummonedRhoaShieldCharge.description: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.

SummonedSpiderViperStrike.name: Viper Strike
SummonedSpiderViperStrike.description: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

SumonRagingSpiritMelee.name: Melee
SumonRagingSpiritMelee.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

Sunder.name: Sunder
Sunder.description: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

SunderAltX.name: Sunder of Earthbreaking
SunderAltX.description: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

SunderAltY.name: Sunder of Trarthus
SunderAltY.description: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

SupportAddedChaosDamage.name: Added Chaos Damage
SupportAddedChaosDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAddedColdDamage.name: Added Cold Damage
SupportAddedColdDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAddedFireDamage.name: Added Fire Damage
SupportAddedFireDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAddedLightningDamage.name: Added Lightning Damage
SupportAddedLightningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAncestralCall.name: Ancestral Call
SupportAncestralCall.description: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

SupportAnnhilation.name: Annihilation
SupportAnnhilation.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.
flavourText: Those citizens of Oriath touched by the
roving storms died most horrible deaths.

SupportArcaneSurge.name: Arcane Surge
SupportArcaneSurge.description: Each supported spell will track how much mana you spend on it, granting a buff when the total mana spent reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, mines or skills with a reservation.

SupportArchmage.name: Archmage
SupportArchmage.description: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportArrogance.name: Arrogance
SupportArrogance.description: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.

SupportArrowNova.name: Arrow Nova
SupportArrowNova.description: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportAutoexertion.name: Autoexertion
SupportAutoexertion.description: Supports warcry skills. Cannot support retaliation skills or modify the skills of minions.

SupportAutomation.name: Automation
SupportAutomation.description: Supports spell skills that are instant and have no reservation. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedAddedChaosDamage.name: Awakened Added Chaos Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedChaosDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedColdDamage.name: Awakened Added Cold Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedColdDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedFireDamage.name: Awakened Added Fire Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedFireDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedLightningDamage.name: Awakened Added Lightning Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedLightningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAncestralCall.name: Awakened Ancestral Call
SupportAwakenedAncestralCall.description: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

SupportAwakenedArrowNova.name: Awakened Arrow Nova
SupportAwakenedArrowNova.description: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportAwakenedBlasphemy.name: Awakened Blasphemy
SupportAwakenedBlasphemy.description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

SupportAwakenedBrutality.name: Awakened Brutality
SupportAwakenedBrutality.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

SupportAwakenedBurningDamage.name: Awakened Burning Damage
SupportAwakenedBurningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

SupportAwakenedCastOnCriticalStrike.name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike
SupportAwakenedCastOnCriticalStrike.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportAwakenedCastWhileChannelling.name: Awakened Cast While Channelling
SupportAwakenedCastWhileChannelling.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportAwakenedChain.name: Awakened Chain
SupportAwakenedChain.description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

SupportAwakenedColdPenetration.name: Awakened Cold Penetration
SupportAwakenedColdPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

SupportAwakenedControlledDestruction.name: Awakened Controlled Destruction
SupportAwakenedControlledDestruction.description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

SupportAwakenedDeadlyAilments.name: Awakened Deadly Ailments
SupportAwakenedDeadlyAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedElementalFocus.name: Awakened Elemental Focus
SupportAwakenedElementalFocus.description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

SupportAwakenedEmpower.name: Awakened Empower
SupportAwakenedEmpower.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportAwakenedEnhance.name: Awakened Enhance
SupportAwakenedEnhance.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportAwakenedEnlighten.name: Awakened Enlighten
SupportAwakenedEnlighten.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportAwakenedFirePenetration.name: Awakened Fire Penetration
SupportAwakenedFirePenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

SupportAwakenedFork.name: Awakened Fork
SupportAwakenedFork.description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

SupportAwakenedGenerosity.name: Awakened Generosity
SupportAwakenedGenerosity.description: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedHextouch.name: Awakened Hextouch
SupportAwakenedHextouch.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportAwakenedIncreasedAreaofEffect.name: Awakened Increased Area of Effect
SupportAwakenedIncreasedAreaofEffect.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

SupportAwakenedLightningPenetration.name: Awakened Lightning Penetration
SupportAwakenedLightningPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

SupportAwakenedMeleeSplash.name: Awakened Melee Splash
SupportAwakenedMeleeSplash.description: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.

SupportAwakenedMultistrike.name: Awakened Multistrike
SupportAwakenedMultistrike.description: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

SupportAwakenedSpellCascade.name: Awakened Spell Cascade
SupportAwakenedSpellCascade.description: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedSpellEcho.name: Awakened Spell Echo
SupportAwakenedSpellEcho.description: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

SupportAwakenedSwiftAffliction.name: Awakened Swift Affliction
SupportAwakenedSwiftAffliction.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

SupportAwakenedUnboundAilments.name: Awakened Unbound Ailments
SupportAwakenedUnboundAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

SupportAwakenedUnleash.name: Awakened Unleash
SupportAwakenedUnleash.description: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedVoidManipulation.name: Awakened Void Manipulation
SupportAwakenedVoidManipulation.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

SupportBallistaTotem.name: Ballista Totem
SupportBallistaTotem.description: Supports any bow or wand attack skill, causing it to summon a ballista totem that uses the skill for you.

SupportBarrage.name: Barrage Support
SupportBarrage.description: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy
SupportBlasphemy.description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

SupportBlastchainMine.name: Blastchain Mine
SupportBlastchainMine.description: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

SupportBlessedCall.name: Blessed Call
SupportBlessedCall.description: Supports Warcries that are not triggered. Supported Warcries create Consecrated Ground, but have lowered area of effect and cooldown recovery.

SupportBlind.name: Blind
SupportBlind.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportBlockChanceReduction.name: Block Chance Reduction
SupportBlockChanceReduction.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportBloodlust.name: Bloodlust
SupportBloodlust.description: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.

SupportBloodsoakedBanner.name: Bloodsoaked Banner
SupportBloodsoakedBanner.description: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
flavourText: "The history of Wraeclast is marked by bloody conflicts. The rise
and fall of empires. Man slaughtered man, never suspecting the
madness lurking under the surface might not have been innate."

SupportBloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
SupportBloodthirst.description: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.

SupportBluntWeaponShockwave.name: Shockwave
SupportBluntWeaponShockwave.description: Deals attack damage in an area.

SupportBonechill.name: Bonechill
SupportBonechill.description: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

SupportBonespire.name: Bonespire
SupportBonespire.description: Supports warcry skills you use yourself.
flavourText: In its madness, Xesht desperately seeks communion.

SupportBrandSupport.name: Arcanist Brand
SupportBrandSupport.description: Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportBrutality.name: Brutality
SupportBrutality.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

SupportBurningDamage.name: Burning Damage
SupportBurningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

SupportCastOnCritTriggered.name: Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCritTriggered.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnCritTriggeredPlus.name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCritTriggeredPlus.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnCriticalStrike.name: Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCriticalStrike.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnDeath.name: Cast on Death
SupportCastOnDeath.description: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when you die. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnMeleeKill.name: Cast on Melee Kill
SupportCastOnMeleeKill.description: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it kills an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnMeleeKillTriggered.name: Cast on Melee Kill
SupportCastOnMeleeKillTriggered.description: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it kills an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnWardBreak.name: Cast on Ward Break
SupportCastOnWardBreak.description: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when your Ward breaks. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.
flavourText: "Prove yourself! Are you a knave, or a knight?
I shall know by the strength of your blows!"

SupportCastWhenDamageTaken.name: Cast when Damage Taken
SupportCastWhenDamageTaken.description: Each supported spell skill will track damage you take, and be triggered when the total damage taken reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhenStunned.name: Cast when Stunned
SupportCastWhenStunned.description: Each supported spell skill will have a chance to be triggered when you are stunned. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannelling.name: Cast while Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannelling.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggered.name: Cast while Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggered.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggeredPlus.name: Awakened Cast While Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggeredPlus.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportChain.name: Chain
SupportChain.description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

SupportChanceToFlee.name: Chance to Flee
SupportChanceToFlee.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportChanceToPoison.name: Chance to Poison
SupportChanceToPoison.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCloseCombat.name: Close Combat
SupportCloseCombat.description: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

SupportClusterTraps.name: Cluster Traps
SupportClusterTraps.description: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps randomly around the targeted location.

SupportColdPenetration.name: Cold Penetration
SupportColdPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

SupportColdToFire.name: Cold to Fire
SupportColdToFire.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCombustion.name: Combustion
SupportCombustion.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCompanionship.name: Companionship
SupportCompanionship.description: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.
flavourText: The Black Sekhema was a formidable fighter
alongside her dekhara, but she was unstoppable
when she fought atop her trusted mount, Shiyo.

SupportConcentratedEffect.name: Concentrated Effect
SupportConcentratedEffect.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.

SupportCongregation.name: Congregation
flavourText: "I have a recurring nightmare... I run...
I scream... but only the dead hear me..."

SupportControlledDestruction.name: Controlled Destruction
SupportControlledDestruction.description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

SupportCooldownRecovery.name: Cooldown Recovery
SupportCooldownRecovery.description: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
flavourText: "The science is... incomprehensible at best. Nearest I can tell, the Arcana exhibits
a blast of wrath once it has been fully charged, and when directed at the Elder
will force it to take on the form it held before it entered our dimension."

SupportCorruptingCry.name: Corrupting Cry
SupportCorruptingCry.description: Supports warcry skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportCriticalStrikeAffliction.name: Critical Strike Affliction
SupportCriticalStrikeAffliction.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCruelty.name: Cruelty
SupportCruelty.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.

SupportCrustaceousGrasp.name: Coursing Current
SupportCrustaceousGrasp.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.
flavourText: Velka reached out her hand. One touch and she
folded, screaming, clawing desperately at her back
as the crustaceous gift burst itself from her spine.

SupportCrystalfall.name: Crystalfall
SupportCrystalfall.description: Supports Slam skills. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.
flavourText: The ancient golem of bone climbs ever upward.
Its body is an engine. Its eyes are fuel.

SupportCullTheWeak.name: Cull the Weak
SupportCullTheWeak.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.
flavourText: "Beidat is the lesser of three evils. The other two desire only
to consume us, but under him, there is a chance to survive...
a chance to serve... if you can prove yourself useful."

SupportCullingStrike.name: Culling Strike
SupportCullingStrike.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

SupportCurseOnHitCurse.name: Hextouch
SupportCurseOnHitCurse.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportCurseOnHitCursePlus.name: Awakened Hextouch
SupportCurseOnHitCursePlus.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportDamageOnFullLife.name: Damage on Full Life
SupportDamageOnFullLife.description: Supports attack skills, providing a bonus to all damage dealt by those skills while your life is full.

SupportDeadlyAilments.name: Deadly Ailments
SupportDeadlyAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportDecay.name: Decay
SupportDecay.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportDevour.name: Devour
SupportDevour.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportDivineBlessing.name: Divine Blessing
SupportDivineBlessing.description: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.

SupportDivineSentinel.name: Divine Sentinel
SupportDivineSentinel.description: Supports skills that create sentinel minions, causing those minions to be created with a beneficial templar aura.
flavourText: "The world will never know our sacrifice, but
we will stand and fight for as long as it takes!"

SupportEarthbreaker.name: Earthbreaker
SupportEarthbreaker.description: Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.

SupportEclipse.name: Eclipse
SupportEclipse.description:
Supports any skill gem.
Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.
flavourText: "Although we are two bodies, we are of one mind, one heart, drifting
through the cosmos, in search of purpose. The moment we cross paths,
both fleeting and eternal, our eyes are opened to our potential."

SupportEfficacy.name: Efficacy
SupportEfficacy.description: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.

SupportEldritchBlasphemy.name: Eldritch Blasphemy
SupportEldritchBlasphemy.description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.
flavourText: Even trapped in stone, the Elder's shadow lingered
in their hearts and coiled around their dreams.

SupportElementalFocus.name: Elemental Focus
SupportElementalFocus.description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

SupportElementalPenetration.name: Elemental Penetration
SupportElementalPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

SupportElementalProliferation.name: Elemental Proliferation
SupportElementalProliferation.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.

SupportEmpower.name: Empower
SupportEmpower.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportEnergyLeech.name: Energy Leech
SupportEnergyLeech.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.

SupportEnhance.name: Enhance
SupportEnhance.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportEnlighten.name: Enlighten
SupportEnlighten.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportEternalBlessing.name: Eternal Blessing
SupportEternalBlessing.description: Supports aura skills that reserve life or mana to create auras around you.

SupportExcommunicate.name: Excommunicate
SupportExcommunicate.description: Supports melee attacks. Does not modify skills used by minions.

SupportFirePenetration.name: Fire Penetration
SupportFirePenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

SupportFissure.name: Fissure
SupportFissure.description: Supports slam skills you use yourself, causing them to create fissures when impacting the ground.
flavourText: "Oh yes, K'Tash understands you. It has a keen swarm-mind
somewhere within its multitudes. It hears your pleas, but
ignores them... because it hates you with a burning fury."

SupportFistofWar.name: Fist of War
SupportFistofWar.description: Supports slam skills, providing a powerful boost when they're used, with a delay before they can be boosted again. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Only skills you use yourself can receive the boost.

SupportFlamewood.name: Flamewood
SupportFlamewood.description: Supports skills which summon totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportFocusedBallista.name: Focused Ballista
SupportFocusedBallista.description: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportFocusedChannelling.name: Focused Channelling
SupportFocusedChannelling.description: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportFork.name: Fork
SupportFork.description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

SupportFortify.name: Fortify
SupportFortify.description: Supports melee attack skills that are not triggered.

SupportFoulgrasp.name: Foulgrasp
SupportFoulgrasp.description: Supports brand skills that can be recalled.
flavourText: "Words without thought drive us
to claw and scrabble in the dirt,
seeking respite found only in pain."

SupportFrostmage.name: Frostmage
SupportFrostmage.description: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
flavourText: Her understanding of the Atlas was not innate. The
more committed she became to understanding it,
the more the knowledge weighed on her.

SupportGenerosity.name: Generosity
SupportGenerosity.description: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
